question: Name the Metro Rail Corporation which has become the first ever project in the country to receive power generated from a waste-to-energy plant.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi metro.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Delhi Metro **has turned into the first at any point project in Quite a while to get power produced from a Waste-to-Energy (WtE) plant.
 
• **Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC)** has begun getting 2 MW power from a **12 MW** limit squander to-energy plant in Ghazipur.
 
• Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) began its tasks with the help of sun-based energy on the Violet line between the** Jawaharlal Nehru **Stadium metro station and to Central Secretariat station.
 
• The Delhi Metro is a mass fast travel (MRT) framework serving Delhi and its outer municipalities of** Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Gurugram, Noida, and Bahadurgarh **in the National Capital Region of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The establishment stone of the task was laid by Indira Gandhi, the Prime Minister of India, on 29 December 1972, and development work began in 1973-74.**
 
• Bangalore Metro Phase 1 with 42.30 km of courses began in** April 2007.**
